verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is a locally run multi-agent video-production app, and an app like this could plausibly expose an API with scoped credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that it consumes third-party keys (Yating, ElevenLabs, Openverse) via configuration and lets users set agent concurrency limits. Neither is the product issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials, and nothing documents that capability.
